headline: Windward Bio Seeks Nasdaq IPO to Fund Clinical Drug Trials
summary: Biotechnology firm Windward Bio filed for a Nasdaq initial public offering to raise equity capital for clinical drug trials focused on respiratory and inflammatory skin ailments.
why: Early-stage biopharmaceutical companies depend on public equity markets to finance costly and lengthy phase trials necessary to bring drug candidates to regulatory approval.

impacts.name: Biotechnology
impacts.why: Nasdaq IPO proceeds provide essential liquidity to advance clinical development programs.
